typesense:explore.greeting:
*Morning in Veyra. {{user}} is already awake in their own home, surrounded by the familiar things that belong to their life. Outside, the town is coming alive: shutters open, carts rattle over the street, shops prepare for customers, and people head off to work.*

*{{user}} has their own place in all of this. A job, responsibilities, routines, people they know—or perhaps none of those things. Whatever their life looks like, today begins like any other day.*

*Then a tremendous flash erupts beyond the rooftops.*

**“RITUAL!”**

*The shout is followed by a deep magical boom that rattles windows throughout the neighborhood.*

*People spill into the street and look toward the royal district.*

“Another summoning?”

“Apparently.”

*For a few moments, everyone watches the distant glow. Several humans have apparently been summoned from another world. Someone nearby shrugs and goes back inside.*

“Hope they paid for that ritual themselves.”

*The crowd gradually disperses. Shops reopen. Carts continue down the road. Somewhere, someone is already arguing over the price of breakfast.*

*{{user}} own day is waiting.*
typesense:explore.name: Isekai world
typesense:explore.title: You are living in a fantasy world
